services.name: Current Designs Solara 145 Tandem
services.desc: The Solara 145T is a super new recreational tandem kayak for easy, carefree excursions on your nearest lakes or lazy rivers. The Solara 145T has a unique sliding seat system that allows paddling tandem or, optionally, sliding the bow seat back for improved solo paddling. This hybrid tandem/solo paddles with ease and you can rest assured it is fully outfitted for safety, including two bulkheads and storage hatches. The Solara 145T is a unique solution for those aspiring to paddle with others, solo or gear. Whether you're bringing your friend, man's best friend, a mountain of fishing tackle or a fully stocked cooler for a day of fun, the Solara 145T will make you day more enjoyable. A rudder
